answer.summary: API types check failed because the types generated from the API no longer match the committed openaev-front/src/utils/api-types.d.ts. This PR's DTO changes made several fields optional (scenario_revision_number, scenario_version_current, scenario_version_latest, scenario_simulations_count), and the committed file was not regenerated. This is deterministic, so a rerun will fail again. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the result.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
